title: Geologic map of the Cameron quadrangle, Calhoun and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2014, Geologic map of the Cameron quadrangle, Calhoun and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-212, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; map face is noise. Symbols legible inline: dg, PEodb, PEs, PEc; Qe and Qhs inferred from placement (flagged). Symbols for moved earth, freshwater marsh ('aHiw'), Sandhills lakebed ('Qak'), Carolina bay ('eb'), East Bethel ('[ aceb'), Duplin sands ('[neds') and Warley Hill not reliably legible and omitted. Thicknesses with '|' as first digit (freshwater marsh, Sandhills lakebed, Carolina bay, East Bethel, Duplin sands, Santee Limestone) and the eolian sand thickness ('1 to 44 / 14 feet', garbled) were not recorded. Kaczorowski 1977 report number and pages garbled. Bodies of water skipped.
SUBSURFACE: page 1 has no cross section on this sheet; one SCGS drill hole number is legible only as OCR 'o9-284'; logs on file at SCGS, not printed. Correlation chart (page 1) shows unconformities separating the Holocene, Pleistocene (Qhs), Pliocene, and Eocene (PEodb, PEs, PEc) units. Vertical datum not stated; base map uses 1927 North American Datum, contour interval 20 feet.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; map face is noise). Units as before; map symbols garbled in the OCR read from the legend boxes on page-image tiles. Thicknesses printed with '|' for the first digit are now recorded as 1 (inferred); the East Bethel thickness line missing from the OCR was read from the image ('to 15 fect'). Correlation chart shows unconformities separating the Holocene, Pleistocene (Qhs), Pliocene (NPds) and Eocene (PEodb, PEs, PEwh, PEc) units. Whole-page image checked: no cross section, structure contours or stated unit-top elevations; SCGS drill holes (09-xxx, 38-xxx) are plotted on the map face by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS), so none is recorded. Kaczorowski 1977 report number and pages garbled. Bodies of water and legend-only symbols not recorded. No vertical datum printed.
